pages.text: The workshop access point. Open it to browse connected storage, craft by hand, or request taught products.$(br2)The Nexus has no storage of its own. It discovers nearby containers within five blocks.

pages.title: Shared access
pages.text: Nearby same-channel Relays, Nexuses, and Storage Crystals connect automatically within 16 blocks.$(br2)Several Nexuses share storage and crafting jobs. Each also acts as a relay.$(br2)A rune bound to the Nexus uses its whole network. Bind a handheld Astral Nexus here for remote access.
